rawFindings.title: Incorrect comment describing className condition in writeObject
rawFindings.explanation: The comment on line 331 incorrectly states the mapping for 'java.util.HashMap' as 'java.utils.HashMap'. This is a typo. Although minor, it may cause confusion for maintainers.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of iMap className in v1 encoder's writeObject
rawFindings.explanation: The code change removed checking obj.$class against 'java.util.Map' (iMap) when deciding whether to treat the object as untyped hash map by setting className to ''. This means objects with $class equal to 'java.util.Map' will not be treated as untyped hash map but rather as typed map, which is a behavior change from previous code. This could break encoding behavior for Huffman valued maps with type 'java.util.Map'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to check both DEFAULT_CLASSNAME.map and DEFAULT_CLASSNAME.iMap to set className to '', ensuring consistent handling of Java Map and iMap types in v1 encoder.
